text_block_list.name: Takoyaki Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Whew, you saved me, Royce-chan! Sorry 
about asking you to fill in for me while I 
hit the restroom!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Not at all! Fufufu, I'm just glad my Level 
1 Takoyaki Flipping Certification came in 
handy♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Once again, Royce and Royce used her 
knowledge and skills to save the day out 
on the town. Her certifications really 
aren't just for show.
choice_data_list: (That said, now even I—)
(That said, now I too—)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. So you're looking to earn some new 
qualifications as well, Trainer?
choice_data_list: I thought I'd try to follow your example
I thought I'd try to follow your example.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Countless days of dedication since her 
youth have made her who she is today.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Then I thought that I, too, should put in 
even more effort for the sake of her 
becoming the "strongest."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"So, when you actually gathered the 
reference materials, they all seemed 
necessary and you couldn't narrow them 
down... I see."
choice_data_list: ...Hm? Hold on, this qualification is...
...Hm? Wait, this license is...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh? An 'Eyewear Maintenance 
Certification'?"
choice_data_list:
I was just vaguely thinking about you, 
and—

I was just vaguely thinking about you, 
and—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: This is... a wonderful qualification!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
First, I'm a glasses-wearer. Having a 
maintenance pro gives immeasurable peace 
of mind for both my mind and vision. And 
as for Trainer-san's own character—
choice_data_list: C-Calm down...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...That said, it really doesn't seem bad. 
Putting my own persona aside, there's no 
doubt I can contribute to her.
choice_data_list: ...Alright! Let's go with this one!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And thanks in part to her support, I 
recently passed with flying colors. I 
thought there would be immediate 
opportunities to put it to use, but—

text_block_list.name: Fallen Boy
text_block_list.text:
"...Whoa, awesome! Where I bumped it 
doesn't hurt anymore! You're a total 
wizard, Sis!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
Food Stall Dude
text_block_list.text:
Yo, sis! Thanks a bunch for helpin' set up 
the stall!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Not at all♪ I'm just glad my "Event Setup 
Assistant" certification came in handy!
choice_data_list:
(...The Glasses Mechanic didn't get any 
screen time at all!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And with that, there continued to be no 
opportunity to put my qualifications to 
use, but—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
“—I see. Your pet cat ran away from home 
and hasn't returned, right?”

text_block_list.name: Pouting Girl
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah... His name is Motsu-chan... He's a 
big, cheeky-looking orange tabby boy, 
but...!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry! Big Sis Royce will bring them 
right back.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I prepared for the scenario of "Me 
Befriending Cats" by acquiring numerous 
cat-related certifications, and now the 
time to use them is finally meow-pon us!

text_block_list.name: Orange Tabby
text_block_list.text: Meow-o?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. Orange tabby, male, chubby build, 
brazen face... Could this kitty be the 
Motsu-chan everyone's talking about?

text_block_list.name: New Brown Tabby
text_block_list.text: Nyaooh...!
choice_data_list: …There's another one!?

text_block_list.name: Orange Tabby Legion
text_block_list.text:
"Nyo-o-o-o...!" "Whoa!" 
"Fugyororobushu...!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
An unexpected swarm!? ...A bunch of cats 
with the exact same pattern, build, and 
brazen attitude!?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Heh, but with the discerning eye of a "Cat 
Care Expert," distinguishing who's a house 
cat is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, at that very moment... the brown 
tabbies all bolted in different 
directions!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Ah, h-hold on a second!? I haven't 
identified it yet!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even Royce and Royce doesn't have the keen 
eye to identify that specific cat in an 
instant...! Here, I should—
choice_data_list: That piercing gaze... That's it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I pull a handkerchief from my pocket— and 
instantly wipe Royce and Royce's glasses! 
Wipe! Wipe! Wipe them to absolute 
perfection!!
choice_data_list: Seiyaaa!!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
O-Ohh?! I can see?! I can see way too 
clearly! My vision is completely crystal 
clear?! I can perceive all seven colors of 
the sun's rays...!
choice_data_list: Now! Get the cat!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me! That subtle clumsiness 
unique to house cats, that total lack of 
danger sense... Motsu-chan, that's you!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Phew... I'm glad Motsu-chan made it back 
safely. ...Though I couldn't have done it 
alone."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Magnificent judgment, Trainer. To think 
you'd wipe my glasses so swiftly in that 
situation…… You truly are a pro.
choice_data_list:
No, well... it was just a 
spur-of-the-moment flash of inspiration.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Reacting on reflex means the technique has 
truly become second nature. It has become 
a part of the foundation supporting you.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu. As expected of my Trainer!
choice_data_list:
Leave the glasses maintenance to me from 
now on.

Leave the glasses maintenance to me from 
now on.

Maybe I should try to master every 
glasses-related qualification...
It's nice being able to do something new.

It's great being able to do something new, 
isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu. As expected of my Trainer!
choice_data_list:
Leave the glasses maintenance to me from 
now on.

Leave the glasses maintenance to me from 
now on.

Maybe I should try to master every 
glasses-related qualification...
It's nice being able to do something new.

It's great being able to do something new, 
isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Yes, please do. And together, we shall 
gain a clear vision—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Let us keep our eyes firmly set on the 
path leading to 'the strongest'!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"That's a wonderful aspiration! Since 
then, I've also been looking into various 
glasses-related certifications."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"‘Eyewear Art Curator,’ ‘Eyewear Culture 
Appraiser,’ ‘Royal Meganist,’ ‘Eyewear 
Artist,’ and so on and so forth...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Perhaps I shouldn't have said that so 
lightly."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it? ...Fufu. It's so familiar to me, 
and yet... I still can't get enough of 
this feeling!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Let us broaden our horizons together to 
new worlds! Starting with glasses, of 
course!"
